name: Mpox
summary: Clade I mpox continues to spread outside Africa, tracked by WHO and UKHSA; no new emergency declared
state: WHO's multi-country mpox situation reports, the latest being its 69th, continue to track clade I transmission in Africa and imported or local cases elsewhere (WHO). UKHSA keeps a list of countries affected by clade I mpox outside Africa (UKHSA). Searches on 26 Nov found no new emergency of international concern and no sharp acceleration, so continued clade I spread outside Africa keeps Watch.
for_you: Follow UKHSA or national health guidance; vaccination is offered to eligible groups at higher risk.
rubric_hit: Clade I spreading outside Africa = Watch; no PHEIC
